chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:
I saw Aba Ja'far عليه السلام come out of the bathhouse, then go on as he was, not washing his feet until he performed salat (prayer).
ai.seo_question: Did Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام wash his feet immediately after leaving the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the observed practice of Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام after leaving the bathhouse. It indicates that he did not wash his feet immediately upon exiting, but deferred that until before performing salat (prayer), making it relevant to discussions of taharah (ritual purity) and prayer practice.
